hooks.name: Standard header on new code files
hooks.description: When the agent creates a Python, SQL or notebook file, add the team header block.

action.prompt: A new code file was just created. If it has no header block yet, add one at the top with: Purpose (one line), Owner (git config user.name), Created (today, YYYY-MM-DD), Inputs (tables or files read), Outputs (tables or files written), and Ticket (if known from the branch name or conversation, otherwise leave blank). Use the file's comment style: '# ' for .py, '-- ' for .sql, and a first markdown cell for .ipynb. For Databricks notebooks saved as .py, keep '# Databricks notebook source' as the very first line and put the header right after it. Skip __init__.py, test fixtures, generated files and files under .kiro/. Do not change anything else.
